name: Avon Food Company
old_description: Founded by family, now led by the next generation, Avon Food Co. blends heritage, innovation, and SQF-certified precision to bring bold flavors to shelves nationwide.
about:
Avon Food Company operates from a 55,000-square-foot facility in Stoughton, Massachusetts. The business was founded in 2002 by Stephen and Heidee Anastos as a small family-run operation focused on sauces, dressings, and marinades. Today, the company is led by their son, Michael Anastos, who has expanded the operation while maintaining its family-owned character.

The company produces liquid and dry food products including sauces, dressings, marinades, and custom spice blends. Its SQF-certified facility houses four dedicated production lines: an electromagnetic filler for high-speed liquid filling, pressure overflow and piston fillers for varied viscosities, an auger filler for dry spices, and a line for 5-gallon pail and bag-in-box packaging. With a team of 35-plus employees, Avon handles everything from research and development and custom formulation to private-label manufacturing, storage, and delivery, producing more than 300 distinct items for clients ranging from startups to established brands.

Avon serves food brands and private-label partners across North America, offering nationwide shipping and regional delivery from its Massachusetts base. Its customer base includes both emerging companies seeking recipe development and scale-up support and larger brands requiring consistent, high-volume co-packing. The company's in-house R&D team assists with flavor testing, ingredient sourcing, and scalability assessments to bring concepts to market-ready products.

Avon emphasizes its family-owned, next-generation leadership as a differentiator, combining heritage with investments in automation and technology. The company cites its SQF and HACCP compliance, allergen management, and traceability programs as the foundation of its quality assurance, while highlighting a partnership-first approach that treats each brand with the same care as its own.
